thread:
maria: heads-up — pushed a tiny API contract tweak to avoid null-embedding churn.
I addressed the review comments, split the flaky sampling tests into a separate file, and added a short migration note in the PR description.
PTAL when you have ~10m. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4212>

sam: looking now, will skim tests first

lee: quick question — did you have to change the cache key format? that could affect Dedicated customers if keys are persisted.

maria: yep — changed the cache key to truncate the input prefix so we don't blow up key sizes. added a compatibility note and a small migration step in the changelog. snippet:
```diff
- cache_key = f"{model}:{input}"
+ cache_key = f"{model}:{input[:64]}"  # keep prefix stable across versions
```

ana: :eyes: can you add a one-line note to the Console docs about the migration? a few customers asked about cache invalidation flows.

maria: done, added one-liner under "Cache keys and upgrades" in docs and linked it from the PR description.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint) — rerun requested by sam — re-run succeeded.

sam: left a tiny wording nit on the error message (see inline). otherwise looks good. PTAL on that line when you push.

maria: fixed the message and added a unit that asserts on the message text. pushed.

lee: lgtm, approving now. :white_check_mark:

sam: also approved, will hold merge until canary window tonight at 23:45 PST to avoid rush-hour traffic.

maria: thanks — scheduling canary. I'll merge after the canary completes cleanly and no regressions are observed.

ana: thanks for splitting tests — makes the flake investigation much easier.

maria: thanks all! ping me if the canary trips, will roll back immediately if any perf regressions show up. :pray:
